# Destructive downgrade drops all tables

The downgrade implementation calls Base.metadata.drop_all(op.get_bind()), which will drop every table present in the Base metadata on the bound database. Running the downgrade can therefore remove all schema objects defined in that metadata and cause data loss.

- `alembic/versions/0001_phase1_schema.py` — `alembic.versions.0001_phase1_schema.downgrade`
